This is Leadwood Solution

A consulting services and IT solutions provider. It utilises emerging digital technologies such as AI , data exchange , cybersecurity and cloud to deliver solutions.

Leadwood is at the forefront of facilitating digital businesses to unlock the power of the data that’s held in the repositories. Data is the lifeblood of the digital economies, to drive innovation, performance, efficiency and overall cost saving.

Leadwood therefore supports private and public organisations to develop data-sharing Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and AI-driven internal capabilities. Its diverse experience, strategic and innovative, can bring substantial value to clients, particularly in an era where agility, innovation, and digital fluency are key competitive drivers
